originalFinding: serviceProxy:1 allowed selecting older control whose fixed-policy parser rejects new full: host rule, for enabled and retained disabled selections; a new reviewed checkout could also try creating such a list while installed helper still lacked support.
changes: stage_control advertises numeric serviceProxyDirectDomains:1 alongside existing serviceProxy:1.

Control admission derives the list only from exact verified saved configuration and requires the new capability for nonempty lists, regardless of enabled state. Missing/wrong/boolean marker fails proxy_unsupported; empty list remains compatible with older serviceProxy:1.
The existing common control guard protects retained rollback and old/candidate recovery before guard/stop; staged candidate is now explicitly checked before prepared journal or any stop.

Proxy writes/preparation and old/candidate recovery require installed control capability only for the target nonempty list. Explicit clear and empty old recovery remain possible; core/disable/rollback cannot select unsupported nonempty generations.
Root transaction fixtures now retain real canonical configuration files rather than fictitious selection hashes for new verified list reads; source side effects remain substituted.

retainedFailedAttempt.reason: The existing busy-after-preparation fixture returned fake b*64 configuration without a file. New verified target-list admission correctly tried reading it; fixture now writes a real canonical empty-list configuration. Original stop/idle/assertions retained.

rootCases: Nonempty enabled/disabled rollback to serviceProxy:1 fails before service events or launcher changes.
Newly staged candidate lacking direct-host capability fails before journal/stop.
Old control recovery refuses without additional changes; capable candidate recovery succeeds.
Candidate recovery to a bound older capability fails before stop.
Old installed helper cannot configure/replace nonempty list or rollback to it; no download/stop/journal; clear while disabled succeeds.
Old installed helper refuses nonempty proxy candidate recovery while empty old recovery succeeds.

retainedRoutingEvidence.scope: Actual Xray routing evidence retained because service_proxy.py and generated configuration bytes did not change in compatibility fix; it is not rebound to a later whole-source digest.
